lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mn4Cu4O12 (reduced formula LiMn2(CuO3)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Mn and Cu each in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors, while Li adopts a tetrahedral environment of four O neighbors; the O centers are three-coordinate, surrounded by Cu, Li, and Mn. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Li tetrahedra and Mn or Cu octahedra, and edge-sharing between Mn and Cu octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
